summary.text: Jodee Etchart is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 51, where Ballotpedia lists her tenure as beginning in 2023, and a physician assistant seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Precious McKenzie.

paragraphs.text: Etchart earned a bachelor's degree in human services from Montana State University-Billings and a bachelor's degree in physician assistant studies from Rocky Mountain College.
Her career experience includes working as a physician assistant.
In the 2025-2026 session Etchart was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Human Services Committee, serving as vice chair of Human Services.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
